## Functional specifications and files
Run coverage-upper after clean review; fresh coveralls report then coverup, focused meaningful coverage fixes. Review all changes, repeat affected checks; run required existing E2E and resolve regressions.
Files/owners: Changed-file tests and owning production code only if a real defect; coverage receipts in issue.
## Tests to add before implementation
Prefer augment existing tests; no implementation mirrors, assertion weakening or global mutable setup. Fresh coverage timeout 600000ms. Re-review fixes to zero findings.
## Branches/paths validated
Success, invalid input, nil/denied actor, stale/concurrent write, unavailable/deleted source, lifecycle cleanup and failure rollback where relevant. No hidden cross-service calls.
## Mocking plan
Real Repo, validated Actions, NodeRouter and domain boundaries. Mock only external provider/conversion HTTP when relevant; runtime dependencies via existing Zaq.Config opts, no global mutation.
## Documentation
Update owner module docs and relevant existing service/BO guide alongside behavior; durable evidence here. Follow docs/documentation.md.
## Action reuse assessment
Verification-only; extend existing test fixtures and public contract tests, no production API solely for tests.
## Validation/dependencies
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/code-quality.md and applicable service guides. Scoped tests + mix q only per implementation issue. Final precommit reserved for final child. Supervisor verifies before closure. New feature E2E remains zaq-kw0.15 -> zaq-kw0.16.
